_readme: Template only. Copy to detection_source.json in this folder, fill it in and delete the '_example' line; the main_*.py scripts refuse to run a config that still has it. Shared: other configs pull it in with "_include", so it is set once. What steps 5 and 6 run the detectors on: here the test split of a YOLO dataset, or one video (see _dataset_video_alternative). For a folder of videos, one per camera, start from detection_source.batch.example.json instead. This is not the dataset a detector is trained on: that is training.data_yaml in training.json.

_dataset_video_alternative._readme: Rename to 'dataset' to evaluate one video. 'labels' can be the folder of .txt files or a CVAT/YOLO export root containing labels/<split>/ (its data.yaml is then used for class names). start_index = label number of the video's first frame (0 if labels start at frame_000000).
_dataset_video_alternative.name: my_video
